name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out, bracing your core with your arms ready at your sides.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees into a squat while swinging your arms back slightly to load your legs.
Explode straight upward by driving forcefully through your feet and swinging your arms up to leave the floor.
Land lightly on your forefeet and let your heels settle as your hips and knees bend to absorb the impact.
tips: Absorb every landing softly with bent knees and hips rather than landing stiff-legged.
Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes during both takeoff and landing.
